verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments and banking API platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product category. The evidence shows only that Asaas publishes its own MCP server for its documentation, which is the server role and does not count toward this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
